title: eu-web-compliance: unified compliance report
description: JSON output of scripts/check-all.mjs (compliance/reports/compliance-report-YYYY-MM-DD.json). It merges the applicability matrix, the AI Act classification and the findings of the four checkers. It is produced by an AI tool: it is not an audit and not legal advice, and it never declares the site conformant.

count.description: Counts of non-conformities (NC) and items to review (NT).

domain.description: One of the five domains of the report.

obligation.description: One row of the applicability matrix, shortened.

domain.description: Domain of the obligation as written in the matrix.

rules_file.description: Reference file of the skill for this obligation.

reasons.description: For a to-confirm row: the answers that must be confirmed.

generator.description: Credit of the skill that produced the report.

disclaimer.description: Warning shown at the top of the report: produced by an AI tool, not an audit, not legal advice.

generated.description: Date and time of the run (ISO 8601).

target.description: Site folder or URL checked, as given.

profile.description: Project profile used for the applicability matrix.

path.description: Path of the profile looked for.

found.description: False when no profile exists: the matrix was computed on an empty profile and every obligation is to confirm.

declares_ai.description: True when the profile declares at least one AI feature (the AI Act classifier was run).

summary.description: Totals over all findings, and per domain.

exit_code.description: Exit code of check-all: 0 no non-conformity, 1 at least one, 2 a checker could not run.

to_confirm.description: Obligations handled as applying until an answer is confirmed.

does_not_apply.description: Obligations that do not apply to this profile.

assumptions.description: Assumed and missing answers of the profile, as given by the matrix.

country_coverage.description: Countries whose national rules the skill does not cover.

error.description: Error message when the matrix could not be computed.

ai_act.description: Output of scripts/ai_act_classify.py when the profile declares AI features; null otherwise.

status.description: ran, failed (no usable report), skipped (excluded by --only), unavailable (script missing).

exit_code.description: Exit code of the checker process.

raw_report.description: Path of the raw checker report, relative to the output folder.

error.description: Error output when the checker failed.

expected.description: Detection of planted defects, when --expected-dir gave a file for this checker.

grouped_fixes.description: Elements that several findings point to: fixing the element once may resolve all of them.

fix_refs.description: Reference files to read for the fix.

not_tested.description: What the checkers say they do not test (union of their limits and not_tested lists).

checker.description: Checker that declared the limit, or check-all.

wcag.description: WCAG success criterion, for accessibility items.

manual_checks.description: Checks a person must perform, each with a one-line procedure.

reference.description: File to read for the full procedure.

origin.description: testing-by-hand (accessibility manual checks), matrix (obligation that applies and that no checker covers), checker-not-run.

documents.description: Documents the project must publish according to the matrix.

template.description: Template of the skill to start from.

status.description: found (a page seems to exist), not-found, not-checked (URL target: only the given page is seen).

pages.description: Pages that seem to be this document, or link to it.

changes.description: Comparison with the previous JSON report found in the output folder; null when there is none.

previous.description: File name of the previous report.

fixed.description: Findings of the previous report absent now (only for checkers that ran both times).

new.description: Findings absent from the previous report.

next_actions.description: Ordered list of what the user should do next.

outputs.description: Files written by the run, relative to the output folder.
